outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 240 pregnant patients divided into two groups: one with gestational age 37-40 weeks (control) and one with gestational age >40 weeks (study).
finding: Maternal and fetal complications, including cesarean section, instrumental delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, sepsis, and acute fetal distress, were higher in the post-term pregnancy group compared to the control group.
